title: [web-social] Type the RPC target as a thenable, not Promise
body: `createClient()` returns a typed SupabaseClient, whose `rpc()` returns PostgrestFilterBuilder implementing PromiseLike rather than Promise. Assigning it to `targetPromise: Promise<any> | null` is therefore a TypeScript error (the builder lacks Promise's catch/finally members), independently of the pending shared-domain dependency. Infer the builder type, use PromiseLike, or wrap the RPC in Promise.resolve before passing it to Promise.all.

title: [web-explore] Preserve linked board routes' sharing metadata
body: The new board-row normalization drops `share_token`, which the previous direct row retained. When a deep-linked public board route is absent from the local routes store, RouteViewer uses this object as `routeForActions`; its Share handler rejects non-owners when `share_token` is absent, even when the database route already has a valid share link. Preserve the route's existing sharing metadata when adding the resolved wall image.

title: [web-explore] Bind modal bookmark rollbacks to their account
body: The newly added modal rollback checks only the route ID. If account A starts a bookmark mutation, the account changes, and B opens the same deep-linked route before A's failed request completes, this setter overwrites B's freshly resolved bookmark state with A's old value. This also affects routes absent from the list, where `derivedOutdoorRouteToView` cannot override the stale value. Capture and validate the originating account/generation before rolling back the modal or releasing its pending lock.

title: [web-explore] Clear incompatible grades when changing discipline
body: Removing the grade-label updates while retaining the automatic grade-system changes leaves an entered label attached to the wrong system. For example, entering `5.12a` and then choosing Boulder now submits `grade_system: 'v_scale'` with `grade_label: '5.12a'`; the form performs no compatibility check before publishing those public route facts. When the discipline changes the grading system, clear the incompatible label instead of retaining it or substituting a fabricated default.

title: [web-social] Scope the preserved target post to its viewer
body: `targetPostRef` is reused by post ID alone and is never cleared when `user.id` changes. Open a linked post outside the first page as A, then switch accounts while remaining on that URL: B's load skips the target RPC and prepends A's cached item. FeedCard initializes its liked, followed, and saved controls from that item, so B sees A's state and can send the opposite mutation. Invalidate or refetch cached target projections on viewer changes rather than carrying them across generations.

title: [web-social] Recheck the generation after the fallback target fetch
body: When the first target lookup returns no post or an error, this fallback introduces another await after the initial generation check. If the mode/account changes while that RPC is pending, the condition only skips prepending the target; execution still reaches `setFeedItems(rows)` and `setHasMore` with the obsolete first-page response. Return on an obsolete generation after this await, before committing any rows, so the new feed cannot be replaced by the old query.

title: [web-social] Reset pagination loading when invalidating its request
body: Start Load older sends and switch Discovery/Following before the request finishes. The new generation correctly rejects that response, but this guarded finally also skips `setIsLoadingMore(false)`, and `loadInitial` never resets the flag. Once the replacement query returns a full page, its Load older sends button remains disabled indefinitely. Reset the old pagination loading state when starting a replacement generation while retaining the stale-response guard.

title: [web-social] Reset mark-all pending state when changing accounts
body: If A starts Mark all read and the account changes before it completes, the new generation guard prevents this finally block from clearing `isMarkingAllRead`. The account-change effect resets the inbox and pagination flags but not this mutation flag, so B's Mark all read control remains disabled even after B's unread notifications load. Clear the previous account's pending mutation state during the account reset.

title: [web-social] Consume the deep-link scroll after revealing its target
body: After a linked post has been revealed, `targetPostId` remains set and this effect reruns on every `feedItems` update. Scrolling down and loading older sends therefore appends the next page and then jumps the viewport back to the original linked post; incrementing a comment count does the same. Track whether the current navigation target has already been revealed so later pagination and discussion updates do not restart its scroll.
